summary: Round 2 (content) passes with one Nit on a proof script. The 7 content commits 105c4393..e8549b2e hold only each week's b0-s*.mp3 clips, the provenance file, and the week file (10/18/10/10/10/10/18 files, verified by git show --name-only). AC13-4 holds: no b1-* mp3 and no manifest header or Phase 12 item changed between phase_base c42918df and e8549b2e (fa47ca23 == c42918df for the manifests, verified). The M2 path rules hold on the 72 shipped clips (l2/media/w0<n>/sentences/b0-s<jj>.mp3, 2-digit index, 8/16/8/8/8/8/16 per week). Each capture p13-sentences-w0<n>.txt reconciles: the per-call chars sum equals the sent: line (137/166/93/142/130/132/127, cumulative running totals consistent), and p13-chars.txt agrees with the provenance text-times-take sum at 927 with every take 1. The cut probe script is sound (Cauchy-Schwarz bounds the NCC to [-1,1]; 7 re-encoded window positive controls must return true; exit 1 on any cut), and my own rerun on the real book audio at HEAD reproduces the committed proof exactly: clips: 72, cuts: 0, highest max-ncc 0.342, positive controls 7/7. The heard list has 72 lines (71 ok, 1 differs: w01 b0-s02 'Mae' for 'May') and matches p13-listen.txt and the log. The L8 grep at HEAD shows no readFileSync/existsSync/.clips/audio.file hit beyond the week read, the take WAV, the output checks, the allowed provenance parse, and the skip-rule hash of the clip itself; the 4 Phase 13 code files have no commit after 993d9642. Gates at HEAD: GREEN_TEST_COMMAND 9 files/559 tests exit 0 (matches the per-commit captures); PROJECT_CHECKS exit 0. The PROJECT_TESTS part-1 failure (8 cases of storytime-print-contract-v2 R14 thai pins) is confirmed pre-existing at the Clips role base 5cd01553 (p13-clips-project-preexisting.txt: 8 failed | 17 passed) and fixed test-only in e0171ef2 (p14-owner-red-r2-print.txt: 25 tests pass). Commits after e8549b2e (8a065306, 684cab4a, 640035c0, e0171ef2, 3a7ede22, 196dc950) and the in-range Phase 14 commits (9f168a4e approval.thai of w01-w08 only; 4c317383 two loops test files; wa-*.mp3 word clips from a318b199) change no Phase 13 code or clip. Round 1 findings F1-F3 were fixed in Red retry R2 1ecc2646 (the M5 text-half case, the --kind all unit case, and the N6 name all present and passing in the 53-test file); F4 was accepted.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nit] review-a: the acceptance proof script measure/runs/storytime_week_package_20261022/p13-ac13.py prints without failing on empty deliverables in sections AC13-4 to AC13-7 (A4-style soft check). Rationale: I built the missing-deliverable fixture (an F9 capture with no st2 rows, an empty cut-proof tail, an empty heard list) and ran the script: AC13-5 prints '[]', '[]', 'heard lines: 0', AC13-6 prints no week rows and 'FAIL rows other than published: []', and the script still exits 0. AC13-1/2/3/8 do compute real 'holds' booleans from the live tree, so missing clips cannot produce a false 'holds: True'; and the committed capture prints correct values that I verified against the raw files, so this phase's evidence stands. Fix route: if the script is reused in a later phase, add a labeled assertion per section (for example 'AC13-6 week rows: 7') that exits nonzero on a short count. No code or test change is needed for Phase 13.

Cut probe (M10): p13-cutprobe.ts holds a true positive control per week (a re-encoded 1.5 s book window must give looksLikeCut true, control max-ncc 1.000 in the capture), the NCC is normalised by sqrt(clip energy * window energy) so Cauchy-Schwarz bounds it to [-1,1] (the early formula fault the Clips role fixed is the correct conj(A)*B form, lines 99-105), and the process exits 1 unless cuts == 0 and all controls are true. My rerun in one heavy-run wrapper at HEAD (bash heavy-run.sh -c 'cd dashboard && npx tsx ../measure/runs/storytime_week_package_20261022/p13-cutprobe.ts') reproduced the committed p13-cut-proof.txt exactly: clips: 72, cuts: 0, highest max-ncc 0.342, positive controls: 7, true: 7, scratch removed: true.
